create.name: Annie Carpenter
create.bio:
Annie Carpenter is an American yoga teacher and the creator of SmartFLOW, a method that joins classical hatha yoga with a dancer's understanding of movement, functional anatomy and attention to the breath and subtle body. She came to yoga as a teenager and trained first as a dancer, performing and teaching at the Martha Graham studio in New York while practising at Swami Satchidananda's Integral Yoga Institute. Later study took in Iyengar yoga, the Ashtanga teaching of Pattabhi Jois, and years at YogaWorks in Los Angeles, where she led its teacher trainings through the 2000s.

She is known as a teachers' teacher: much of her work now is running SmartFLOW trainings, from foundation courses through advanced modules that add up to a 500-hour certificate, together with mentorships that pair asana and pranayama with study of texts such as the Upanishads. Her classes are precise but playful, with options to make each pose easier or harder, and she tends to frame practice as self-inquiry rather than performance. She teaches mainly in the San Francisco Bay Area, at studios in Oakland and San Francisco, leads workshops and retreats in the US and abroad, and also offers recorded courses online.

courses.title: Svadhyaya: SmartFlow Mentorship
courses.description: A ten-week mentorship for yoga teachers and committed students, with small-group meetings, regular classes, teaching feedback and study of the Upanishads. It can be joined in person, by livestream or by recording, and counts as 100 hours towards her advanced training.

courses.title: SamKrama: The Art of Sequencing
courses.description: A four-day, 30-hour module at NEST Yoga in Oakland on building yoga classes with a clear arc, from a strong morning practice to afternoons spent mapping sequences and variations. It is also available by livestream with 30 days of recordings.
courses.price: $699 Full Price; $625 Early Bird before February 1, 2027

courses.title: 300 Hour SmartFLOW Teacher Training
courses.description: An advanced, modular training for teachers who already hold a 200-hour certificate, taken at their own pace over one to three years. Completing it with a 200-hour course leads to a 500-hour SmartFLOW certificate.

courses.title: SmartFLOW online courses
courses.description: Recorded video courses for students and teachers: two Heart of SmartFLOW courses on the method's foundations and a shorter course on the bandhas, also sold as a bundle. They are the online prerequisite for her advanced training.
